card.fact_statement: The CDU/CSU won 172 constituency seats in the 2025 German federal election.
card.source_span: The CDU/CSU won 172 constituency seats, while the SPD got 44 and the AfD 42.

card.fact_statement: The Liberal Party won 169 seats in the 2025 Canadian federal election.
card.source_span: Although the party secured 169 seats—falling three seats short of the 172 needed for a majority—it successfully formed a minority government.
